archimate:Outcome.name: Unique and Verifiable Health Worker ID
archimate:Outcome.documentation:
The definitive, measurable achievement of assigning a single, lifelong digital identifier to every healthcare professional nationwide that is cryptographically secure and verifiable across all systems. This milestone ensures that a worker's identity, professional credentials, and employment history are permanently linked to one undeniable profile.
Reaching this outcome completely eliminates identity fraud, duplicate profiles, and the administrative nightmare of tracking staff who change names or move between public and private clinics. For payroll, it provides an uncompromised anchor point, ensuring that salary distributions, benefits, and shift differentials are accurately mapped to the exact individual who performed the work.
Example: "The universal rollout of the Unique and Verifiable Health Worker ID, enabling the payroll system to instantly authenticate a nurse's identity and active license via a secure digital token before releasing monthly funds."
